node.title: Re: Help checking program return values
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Is there a module or library I can use to automatically catch all of the "bad" return values so I don't have to code all of the enumerations of signals and return values myself?

[mod://IPC::System::Simple] has some pretty nice error handling. For other modules, see my post [id://1180578|here].
